dedupe_keys.name: ahp and random forest landslide webgis

description: This repository publishes the research team's PostGIS-based workflow for updating landslide-susceptibility maps. It combines rainfall interpolation, an analytic-hierarchy weighted overlay and a Random Forest classifier, with WMS output and CesiumJS visualisation. Inputs include rain-station observations, slope, lithology, land use, aspect and distances to rivers and roads; outputs are continuous and classified susceptibility rasters and ROC comparisons. The documented spatial coverage uses 10-m grids in EPSG:32633 and a temporal resolution of two-day accumulated rainfall. Source is free under CC0-1.0, with processing commands and database requirements. A limitation is that weights, rainfall normalisation and classifier settings are fixed to the example configuration and require reassessment elsewhere; the authors describe only an early-stage contribution toward a digital twin. The workflow can prepare landslide exposure inputs for road and drainage simulations. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) supplies related network context. No raster, station table or zipped case data was downloaded.
name: AHP and Random Forest landslide WebGIS
